Title: RLC AM PDU and sequence-number fidelity
CurrentProblem: RLC AM is explicitly a simplified non-bit-exact 12-bit-SN implementation with a custom AMD header.
RequiredImplementation: Implement exact TS 38.322 AMD PDU formats for 12- and 18-bit SN, SI/SO rules, window variables, segmentation and re-segmentation.
MandatoryAcceptance: Bit-exact 12/18-bit AMD vectors; wrap/window boundaries; no padding/clamping; no waveform/state change for invalid tuples.

Title: RLC AM polling, STATUS and timers
CurrentProblem: Polling uses PollEveryNPDU and STATUS contains only ACK_SN plus a simplified NACK list; t-PollRetransmit, t-StatusProhibit, pollPDU/pollByte and complete E1/E2/E3/NACK-range behavior are missing.
RequiredImplementation: Implement event-sourced AM polling, exact STATUS PDU, segment NACKs, NACK ranges, t-PollRetransmit, t-Reassembly and t-StatusProhibit.
MandatoryAcceptance: Independent STATUS vectors; loss/reordering/resegmentation campaigns; exact timer transitions; maxRetxThreshold and re-establishment tests.

Title: RLC UM formats, reassembly and window
CurrentProblem: UM is abstract; although 6/12-bit SN exists, header/reassembly and timer behavior are not proven bit-exact across all SI/SO and wrap cases.
RequiredImplementation: Implement exact UMD PDU formats, RX_Next_Reassembly/RX_Next_Highest/RX_Timer_Trigger state, t-Reassembly and delivery/discard rules.
MandatoryAcceptance: Complete-SDU, first/middle/last, SO, wrap, duplicate and out-of-window vectors for 6/12-bit SN.

Title: RLC entity lifecycle and bearer ownership
CurrentProblem: RLC mode/state is not fully owned by an RRC-installed bearer configuration and re-establishment/release procedures are incomplete.
RequiredImplementation: Create immutable bearer/entity identities, configuration epochs, TM/UM/AM lifecycle, re-establishment, reset, release and statistics isolation.
MandatoryAcceptance: SRB0/SRB1/SRB2/DRB entity creation, reconfiguration, release and handover continuity tests with no cross-bearer leakage.

Title: PDCP COUNT, PDU formats and state variables
CurrentProblem: PDCP is simplified; SN is used directly without complete HFN/COUNT, RX_DELIV/RX_NEXT/RX_REORD/TX_NEXT and exact SRB/DRB PDU/control-PDU behavior.
RequiredImplementation: Implement exact 12/18-bit PDCP headers, 32-bit COUNT, HFN progression, reordering/discard/status/data-recovery and control PDUs.
MandatoryAcceptance: COUNT wrap boundary, header, reordering, discard timer, status report, data recovery and duplicate-delivery vectors.

Title: PDCP security
CurrentProblem: Security supports NEA0/NIA0 plus simulator XOR/SHA-256 hooks; exact algorithm inputs, key ownership and activation timing are incomplete.
RequiredImplementation: Implement bounded 128-NEA2/128-NIA2 alongside NEA0/NIA0 using COUNT, BEARER, DIRECTION and RRC-installed keys; activate only after SecurityModeCommand/Complete.
MandatoryAcceptance: Independent AES-CTR/CMAC vectors; wrong COUNT/bearer/direction/key failures; integrity-before-decompression and decipher-before-delivery ordering.

Title: PDCP duplication, split paths and header compression
CurrentProblem: ROHC is a custom 0xF0 marker; duplication, status, data recovery, split bearer, DAPS, ROHC/EHC/UDC procedures are incomplete.
RequiredImplementation: Implement only explicitly selected bounded features. Add exact PDCP duplication/path state first; keep ROHC/EHC/UDC/DAPS unsupported until independent vectors exist.
MandatoryAcceptance: Duplicate suppression and path selection tests; unsupported features reject during planning; no custom marker in strict path.

Title: SDAP PDU and QoS-flow mapping
CurrentProblem: SDAP uses one custom header, silently ignores malformed mapping and falls back to DefaultLCID. Exact UL/DL headers, end-marker and reflective mapping are incomplete.
RequiredImplementation: Implement exact DL and UL SDAP data headers, end-marker control PDU, QFI-to-DRB mapping, default-DRB and reflective QoS state from RRC.
MandatoryAcceptance: All QFI 0..63 headers, UL/DL difference, end-marker, remapping, RDI/RQI, missing-QFI and stale-epoch tests.

Title: RRC ASN.1 encoding
CurrentProblem: RRC messages use JSON, while the existing SIB1 encoder is a custom anchor bit layout labelled UPER.
RequiredImplementation: Introduce a Release-18 ASN.1 module set and unaligned PER codec for the bounded message profile; JSON remains diagnostics only.
MandatoryAcceptance: Frozen independent UPER vectors and decode/re-encode equality for every enabled message; unknown extensions and constraint violations fail closed.

Title: RRC state and procedure engine
CurrentProblem: RRC is essentially IDLE/CONNECTED with synthetic attach structs and local hooks; exact transactions, timers and procedure failures are incomplete.
RequiredImplementation: Implement event-sourced RRC_IDLE/RRC_INACTIVE/RRC_CONNECTED state, transaction IDs, timers and bounded setup, security, capability, reconfiguration, release, re-establishment and resume.
MandatoryAcceptance: Message-sequence, timer-expiry, duplicate, wrong-transaction, rollback and state-convergence tests at both UE and gNB.

Title: Radio bearer configuration
CurrentProblem: RRCSetup contains a tiny srb1 struct rather than complete RadioBearerConfig ownership and atomic lower-layer application.
RequiredImplementation: Implement typed SRB/DRB/PDCP/RLC/SDAP/LC/CellGroup configuration and two-phase validate/commit with configuration epochs.
MandatoryAcceptance: Atomic add/modify/release; rejected config changes no layer; successful config produces matching RRC/RLC/PDCP/SDAP/MAC state.

Title: Handover and mobility coupling
CurrentProblem: Handover methods are stubs and A3 is a local counter; target context, reconfigurationWithSync, RA, bearer re-establishment and failure recovery are incomplete.
RequiredImplementation: Implement bounded intra-frequency handover driven by filtered MeasurementReport, source/target contexts, target RA, path switch abstraction, PDCP/RLC handling and completion/failure.
MandatoryAcceptance: No-oracle measurement-to-HO sequence, target-access, interruption, packet continuity, T304 expiry, rollback and wrong-target tests.

Title: NAS and 5GC boundary
CurrentProblem: RRCSetupComplete embeds a synthetic RegistrationRequest; exact N1/N2, NGAP and 5GC state are not implemented.
RequiredImplementation: Define a typed RAN-to-NAS/N2 boundary. Keep full NAS/5GC outside the mandatory RAN profile unless a separately versioned exact profile is implemented.
MandatoryAcceptance: Synthetic NAS cannot mark registration successful; missing external NAS result leaves state pending; optional exact profile requires independent TS 24.501/NGAP vectors.

Title: Traffic, session and QoS models
CurrentProblem: Traffic is primarily bits-per-TTI, global RNG and simple TCP/FTP proxies; packet/session/PDU-set/5QI and transport feedback are incomplete.
RequiredImplementation: Create immutable packet, session, flow and PDU-set events with named random streams; implement bounded CBR, Poisson, periodic, burst, XR/PDU-set, mMTC and trace replay. Keep TCP/QUIC as study profiles unless packet-accurate.
MandatoryAcceptance: Seed reproducibility, arrival distributions, session transitions, 5QI/PDB/PER/PDU-set deadlines and queue/drop tests.

Title: End-to-end lineage and connected-mode validation
CurrentProblem: Packet-to-SDAP-to-PDCP-to-RLC-to-MAC-to-HARQ-to-delivery conservation and independent protocol vectors are incomplete.
RequiredImplementation: Add immutable lineage, first-delivery de-duplication, byte/bit conservation, full-stack event logs, negative tests and multi-seed campaigns.
MandatoryAcceptance: Zero orphan/unowned/duplicate bytes; exact PDU hashes; latency/goodput/drop accounting; all mandatory artifacts and tests complete.
